algorithm_invariants.alpha: fixed within each member; decade grid 1e-1 through 1e6
algorithm_invariants.selector: capped first-order H0 versus H0-initialized L-BFGS; initial tie H0; one-way L-BFGS takeover within a frozen subproblem
algorithm_invariants.recovery: 320 calls, 15 inner calls, bicriteria merge, I_perp rtol 0
algorithm_invariants.endpoints: bitwise fixed; canonical joint E/F preloaded as shared inherited cache entries before the first optimization query
algorithm_invariants.eligible_states: initial or fully reparameterization-committed; partial tails quarantined

allowed_system_only_differences: canonical BB Amber14-all plus implicit/gbn2 CPU/double joint oracle
call-free nonperiodic sparse FFrbk construction acceleration with unchanged matrix entries and rebuild frequency
explicit path-history storage mode that is never read by the online algorithm
forbidden_drift: rescaling alpha, r, eta, or max step by atom or image count
changing FFrbk rebuild frequency or shifted solve
online dense metrics or baseline feedback

number_of_forces.primary_axis: all physical joint getState attempts made by the optimization member, exactly the 30 internal-image cache misses; fixed endpoints are shared inherited cache hits
number_of_forces.endpoint_policy: the canonical endpoint E/F arrays are hash-verified and preloaded before any query; endpoint getState attempts and endpoint cache misses must both equal zero
number_of_forces.optimization_internal_nf: identical to Number of Forces and retained for matched lookup against the formal ODE-NEB index
number_of_forces.failure_policy: a failed getState attempt still counts; the member is invalid/failed and logs are preserved

execution_gate: immutable registrations/execution_authorizations/{label}.json binds the exact label plus the member registration, campaign preregistration, migration contract, and staged-search protocol hashes; no authorization is present in this construction
